Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: Misidentification of Historical Context - The Planner incorrectly identified Warren G. Harding as the president associated with the Versailles Treaty defeat, when it was actually Woodrow Wilson. This decision was made without sufficient source validation and led to an unfounded conclusion about Harding having a child unrelated to the historical event in question. This aligns with the error of sequential misinterpretation where premature confirmation of information occurs without thorough corroboration.
